description: Instagram allows users to download photos and videos they have posted on Instagram directly to their smartphones' camera roll. This feature comes in handy if a user has deleted the photo or video from their handset to free up storage or for any other reason. Instagram also offers the ability to automatically download each time a user posts a video or photo on the social media platform
title: How to Download Your Instagram Photos and Videos: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: BSNL users can check their active recharge plan, remaining validity and account details through multiple channels. Depending on the method available to you, you can use USSD codes, WhatsApp, the BSNL Selfcare app or customer care to access your account information. The Selfcare app provides a central place to view plan details and balance, while customer care can help users who prefer speaking to a representative. Checking these details regularly can help you keep track of your plan and recharge when required.
title: How to Check BSNL Prepaid Plan and Validity on Your Phone

description: Lava Virat Curve 5G, Poco M8 Power and Vivo T5 Lite 5G are positioned in the sub-Rs. 25,000 segment in India. All three smartphones feature 120Hz displays, 5G connectivity and large batteries, but differ considerably in their processors, cameras and charging capabilities. Here we have a detailed comparison of the Lava Virat Curve 5G, Poco M8 Power and Vivo T5 Lite 5G based on their price in India and specifications.
title: Lava Virat Curve vs Poco M8 Power vs Vivo T5 Lite: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Camera phones under Rs. 75,000 offer a mix of dedicated telephoto cameras, high-resolution primary sensors, ultrawide lenses and optical image stabilisation. The Oppo Reno 16 5G and Vivo V70 Elite feature triple rear camera setups, while the Samsung Galaxy S25 adds a dedicated telephoto camera. The Google Pixel 10a focuses on computational photography with a dual-camera system, and the Motorola Edge 70 Max combines a 50-megapixel primary camera with an ultrawide lens. These phones also differ in displays, chipsets, batteries and charging support.
title: Best Camera Phones Under Rs 75,000 in India: Reno 16, Samsung Galaxy S25, Motorola Edge 70 Max, and More

description: Sometimes a brand-new phone number is hard to remember. And there are times when you have temporarily swapped your SIM and forgotten which SIM card is yours. Whether you are or aren’t in a sticky situation, here are a few ways to quickly find and check your own number.
title: How to Check Your Mobile Number on Jio, Airtel, Vi and BSNL

description: Here we have covered some of the best gaming smartphones currently available under Rs. 50,000 in the country. Our list includes the latest models such as the Redmi Turbo 5 and Motorola Edge 70 Pro+, among others.  All are gaming-oriented models, but they differ in terms of hardware features and pricing. Poco X8 Pro Max and OnePlus Nord 6 pack 9,000mAh batteries
title: Best Gaming Phones Under Rs. 50,000 in India: Poco X8 Pro Max, Redmi Turbo 5 and More

description: Google allows users to scan documents directly from the Google Drive app using their Android smartphone. Apart from this, various smartphone makers, like Samsung, offer a built-in tool, allowing users to scan documents from their Android handset. There are multiple benefits of scanning documents directly from your smartphone. It helps you save cost as you do not have to purchase a separate scanner to scan documents. It also offers greater convenience compared to a traditional scanner.
title: How to Scan Documents With an Android Phone: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Oppo's F series has evolved alongside the changing priorities of smartphone buyers in India over the years. The company moved from selfie-focused models to phones built around design, durability, fast charging, and increasingly capable cameras. The next chapter is now set to take shape with the upcoming launch of the Oppo F35 5G. In the days leading up to its debut, the company has begun revealing several details about the upcoming handset. It is expected to arrive in two colour options — blue and orange. As Oppo approaches a decade of the F Series in India, here is a look back at the models that launched over the years.
title: 10 Years, 15+ Phones: The Complete Oppo F Series Timeline
